mentions.name: Vestiges
mentions.description: A 2D narrative strategy roguelite built in Godot. Development continues with the game being set up for a Steam release; a playable demo is technically ready to ship, but release is held back while the in-game writing is improved. The developer also moved to a Linux laptop and refined the development environment.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've continued working on my game project, Vestiges, which is a 2D narrative strategy roguelite made in Godot.
